frozen_recipe.note: the reconstruction network and its ordinary loss remain in every arm

contrasts_frozen_before_runs.synthetic_K: K(i,s) = 100*[F(i,C=1,s) - F(i,C=0,s)] in percentage points, where F = A_smooth - A_perlin (image AUROC) at input state i, derivative matching off, seed s; reported for both input contexts and every seed with the absolute family scores
contrasts_frozen_before_runs.real_DBT: D=incpl-in-cpl+base, B=incpl-max(in,cpl), T=incpl-base on real image AUROC
contrasts_frozen_before_runs.decision_rule: mechanism persists => K adverse on screw under the stronger recipe; disappears => recipe dependence becomes the central finding; either outcome reported

evaluator_audit: LIGHTWEIGHT factorial baseline run fact_screw_base (seed 42, 8-epoch gray-128 recipe): independently recomputed AUROC 0.374 matches results/raw/fact_screw_base_eval.json. Separately, the stronger-recipe pilot run ref_screw_base_s42 (this protocol's 700-epoch recipe) evaluates at 0.778028 (results/raw/ref_screw_base_s42_eval.json, released under artifact/ref_pilot/) -- above chance, as reported in the paper
deviations_from_original_DRAEM: natural-image source from project data/src_screw rather than DTD textures
gray-128 input with base width 16 rather than RGB 256 with DRAEM widths
matched twin code base rather than the authors' implementation
external-source audit recipe as previously documented in Section V-B

primary_contrast.definition: K on screw, input OFF, mean over seeds 42/0/1
primary_contrast.rule: adverse mean with >=2/3 seeds negative at full precision
primary_contrast.timing_note: the original protocol froze K's general definition before any runs; the primary-contrast specification (screw/input-off, 2-of-3 rule) was clarified in ref_protocol_analyze.py after the seed-42 screw pilot was observed (-31.3 pp) and before the remaining seeds and categories were scored. This is a clarification of the earlier plan, not a full preregistration claim; the earlier wording is retained in Git history
